author: AlwaysTiredAlot
quote: Best looking game I have ever seen as far as graphics but I am totally disappointed that ideologues decided to use this potentially good game to shove their beliefs down my throat at the expense of fun and entertainment.  I can't bring myself to finish the game and I wish I didn't give them my money.  I swear they are belly laughing that they ruined the game for people they don't agree with.  We all know this isn't fun and the messaging and design were made to slight me and my beliefs.
